name: Hive 1.11.2
notes: Fixes the workspace label showing a chat's internal worktree path (chat-<hash>) instead of your project folder when switching between workspaces. The editor, terminal, and Diff still operate on the active chat's isolated worktree; the workspace name/folder shown in the UI now always reflects your linked folder. Patch on 1.11.0's per-workspace directories and per-chat worktrees.
